acceptanceCriteria: A recorded decision states whether an unproved git-observation cleanup should stay SOURCE_CHANGED or get its own outcome/refusal code, citing the governing spec requirement.
If changed: spec row, code and a focused test updated together.
body: Residual from the V1-1392/1324/1294 internal/tasks flakes lane (PR #918, branch claude/tasks-flakes-1392-1324-1294, head 887ad7cab, base 32c57367d; darwin go1.27.2, 12 cores). While fixing PSRSweepMismatchRetries/AmbiguousResponse, the lane observed that when the git observation's cleanup cannot be proved (the observation bound expires before cleanup is confirmed), the sweep classifies the case SOURCE_CHANGED. That conflates 'source changed' with 'could not prove cleanup'. Product question, not changed in #918.
title: question: an unproved git-observation cleanup in the PSR sweep is classified SOURCE_CHANGED; should it be a distinct unproved-cleanup outcome?
